endorsements.title: Principles for augmented intelligence development, deployment, and use
endorsements.quote: vi) D escription of how impacted populations were engaged during the AI lifecycle.

commentary.bottom_line: One guidance document recommends that AI vendors describe how impacted populations were engaged during the AI lifecycle, but no supplied study tests whether requiring this documentation changes the AI that health systems buy or the outcomes patients experience. No supplied study documents the hazard either, so the recommendation currently rests on expert guidance alone.

perspectives.view: The evidence base contains zero studies testing the practice and zero studies documenting the hazard. Under GRADE conventions, certainty cannot be rated above no direct evidence. The single endorsement is a guidance statement using "should" language, which reflects expert judgment and does not substitute for comparative data on procurement or patient outcomes.

The only supporting source is one set of principles for augmented intelligence that lists a description of population engagement as a documentation item. That source is guidance, not a statute or regulation, so a health system adopting this requirement would be setting a contractual expectation rather than enforcing an existing legal duty.

commentary.research_gap: No study examines whether vendor documentation of population engagement is accurate, whether it differs across products, or whether requiring it in procurement is associated with differences in model performance, bias, patient trust, or harm. A useful first step would compare AI tools procured with and without such documentation on subgroup performance and patient-reported experience after deployment.
commentary.underserved_note: No study tested the practice, so no test included Medicaid, safety-net, limited English proficiency, or low-literacy populations. Health systems serving these populations have no evidence on whether vendor engagement documentation reflects their patients or predicts how the AI will perform for them.
